setupToken.title: Finish setting up Bifrost
setupToken.subtitle: Dashboard authentication is not configured, so the API is locked. Enter the setup token to continue and create an admin account.
setupToken.whereToFind: Where do I find the setup token?
setupToken.instructionsIntro: The setup token is a secret the operator sets on the server. Set it one of two ways, then restart Bifrost:
setupToken.instructionConfig: Add {{setupToken}} at the top level of {{configFile}}. It accepts a literal value, an {{envRef}} reference, or a {{vaultRef}} reference:
setupToken.instructionsApi: API clients send the same value in the {{header}} header. The token stops working once dashboard authentication is enabled.
setupToken.notConfigured: No setup token is configured on this server, so setup cannot continue yet.
setupToken.errorUnreachable: Could not reach Bifrost. Check that the server is running.
setupToken.errorStatus: Bifrost returned {{status}} while checking the token
